Table 2. Headline inflation is projected to decline in most countries
Note: Difference from December 2024 OECD Economic Outlook in percentage points, based on rounded figures. The G20 aggregate uses
moving nominal GDP weights at purchasing power parities (PPPs). Revisions to PPP estimates affect the difference in the aggregate. Based
on data available up to 13 March 2025.
1. The European Union is a full member of the G20, but the G20 aggregate only includes countries that are also members in their own right.
2. Spain is a permanent invitee to the G20.
3. Fiscal years, starting in April.
Source: OECD Interim Economic Outlook 117 database; and OECD Economic Outlook 116 database.
